scenes.title: New 2-bed Airbnbs in Jamaica ask £100 a night. Hosts with 50+ reviews charge £90
scenes.vo: Brand-new two-bed Airbnbs in Jamaica ask about a hundred pounds a night. Those with fifty-plus reviews charge about ninety.

scenes.desc: Median nightly rate, 2-bed Airbnbs with no reviews yet (about $134 US)
scenes.vo: That's across over six hundred two-beds with no reviews yet, about a hundred and thirty-four US dollars a night.

scenes.desc: Median nightly rate, 2-beds with 10–49 reviews (about $114 US)
scenes.vo: Two-beds with ten to forty-nine reviews sit lower still, at around eighty-five pounds.
So don't plan on the asking rates of new listings. Price on what established hosts actually charge, and remember that's gross, before costs.
Run your own numbers free with the APG Deal Analyser, in pounds, US dollars or Jamaican dollars. Link in my bio.
